title: 5 Easy Passive Income Streams for Beginners Over 50 (Work From Home)
summary: A retiree pitches people over 50 on digital products, affiliate links, YouTube, paid communities and master resell rights as passive income.

assertions.quote: they're sustainable and they actually work even if you've never made one single buckaroo online before
The beauty of a digital product is that you create them once and you sell them over and over and over again.
one of the most profitable things that you can sell because you keep 100% of the profit is a digital product
once you set it up, it runs on autopilot

verdicts.note: Affiliate links earn small commissions passively once content has traffic, but without an audience they earn nothing.

assertions.quote: YouTube videos can keep ranking and working for you months and even, yes, years later
Communities can be completely free or set up as a paid membership for reoccurring monthly income.

verdicts.note: A few large communities earn well, but most paid communities have few members and high churn; the earnings shown are platform outliers.

assertions.quote: you have the license to resell that exact program yourself and keep 100% of the profit

verdicts.note: Master-resell-rights schemes sell the same course to buyers who mostly earn by recruiting further buyers, so the market saturates; the FTC has acted against such income claims.
